name: fruit_choose
text: A standing customer selects one grapefruit with the right hand, grips its near side, lifts it above the fruit crate, draws it towards the chest to inspect it while looking down, then gently puts the same fruit back in its original place. Clear pickup, raised inspection and deliberate return. The left arm stays down. Feet stay planted, torso stays outside the stall.
